_comment: Expansion 3 part D.1: level 2 spells of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md).

arcane_vigor.name: Arcane Vigor
arcane_vigor.text: A bonus action: you draw on your own life force and heal 2d6 and your casting modifier. The book spends Hit Point Dice here; this game rolls d6s instead. Each higher slot adds one more d6.

barkskin.name: Barkskin
barkskin.text: A bonus action: a willing creature's skin takes on the look and toughness of bark for an hour, so its Armour Class is at least 17.

blindness_deafness.name: Blindness/Deafness
blindness_deafness.text: A foe within 120 feet must make a Constitution save or go blind for a minute, trying again at the end of each of its turns. The deafness the book also allows is not in the game. One more foe for each higher slot.

blur.name: Blur
blur.text: Your body swims out of focus (concentration, a minute): every attack against you is made with disadvantage, except by those who see through illusion.

calm_emotions.name: Calm Emotions
calm_emotions.text: A wave of calm over 20 feet (concentration): hostile people must make a Charisma save or stand down and wait, until they are hurt. The book's option of shielding friends from fear and charm is left out.

cloud_of_daggers.name: Cloud of Daggers

again.name: Cloud of Daggers: moved
again.text: While the spell holds, an action moves the cloud to another spot you can see.

cloud_of_daggers.text: Spinning blades fill a 5-foot cube up to 60 feet away (concentration): 4d4 to all inside, and to anyone who walks in or ends a turn there. An action moves it. Each higher slot adds 2d4.

cordon_of_arrows.name: Cordon of Arrows
cordon_of_arrows.text: Four arrows are planted in your space for eight hours. Any enemy who comes within 30 feet is shot at, Dexterity save or 2d4 piercing, until the arrows are spent (here, 20 damage in all). Extra ammunition from higher slots is not counted.

crown_of_madness.name: Crown of Madness
crown_of_madness.text: A spectral crown on a person's head (concentration): on a failed Wisdom save its action goes on a blow at its own friends, and it saves again at the end of each turn. The book's Magic action to keep control is not asked of you.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.text: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot-radius sphere up to 60 feet away (concentration, ten minutes). Darkvision cannot see through it, and no ordinary light can shine there. Casting it on an object is not in the game.

dragons_breath.name: Dragon's Breath

effects.text: {name} breathes in, and a fire builds behind the teeth.

again.name: Dragon's Breath: the exhale
again.text: While the spell holds, an action breathes out a 15-foot cone: 3d6 of the worst damage type for them, Dexterity save for half.

dragons_breath.text: A bonus action gives a creature a dragon's breath (concentration). Here the spell works on you alone, not on a friend you touch. Each turn an action breathes a 15-foot cone of 3d6 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

enlarge_reduce.name: Enlarge/Reduce
enlarge_reduce.text: Only the shrinking half is in the game (concentration): a foe within 30 feet must make a Constitution save or shrink, striking 1d4 less hard and with disadvantage on Strength. Enlarging a friend waits.

flame_blade.name: Flame Blade

effects.text: {name} draws a blade of fire from the empty air.

again.name: Flame Blade: a stroke
again.text: While the spell holds, an action strikes with the blade: a melee spell attack for 3d6 fire plus your casting modifier.

flame_blade.text: A bonus action evokes a blade of fire in your hand (concentration, ten minutes). Each turn an action strikes with it: a melee spell attack for 3d6 fire plus your casting modifier. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

flaming_sphere.name: Flaming Sphere

again.name: Flaming Sphere: rolled
again.text: While the spell holds, a bonus action rolls the sphere to a new spot, and whoever it rolls into must save.

flaming_sphere.text: A ball of fire on the ground up to 60 feet away (concentration). Anyone ending a turn next to it makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 fire, half on a save. A bonus action rolls it along. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

gust_of_wind.name: Gust of Wind
gust_of_wind.text: A strong wind blasts 60 feet from you (concentration): everyone in the line makes a Strength save or is thrown 15 feet back. The line here is only five feet wide, not ten, and later turns and the wind's other tricks are not in the game.

heat_metal.name: Heat Metal

again.name: Heat Metal: the metal flares
again.text: While the spell holds, a bonus action burns the same creature again for 2d8 fire.

heat_metal.text: A foe's metal glows red-hot (concentration): 2d8 fire now, and again each turn as a bonus action. A failed Constitution save leaves it unable to fight properly for a turn. Here any foe will do, metal or not. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.text: A creature you touch vanishes (concentration, an hour) until it attacks, hurts someone or casts a spell; in a town nobody sees what it does. One more creature for each higher slot.

magic_weapon.name: Magic Weapon
magic_weapon.text: A bonus action: your own weapon turns magical for an hour, +1 to attack and damage; +2 with a slot of level 3 to 5, +3 with level 6 or more. The book lets you touch another's weapon; here it is your own.

melfs_acid_arrow.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
melfs_acid_arrow.text: A green arrow of acid at a foe up to 90 feet away: a hit does 4d4 and 2d4 more at the end of its next turn; a miss still splashes for half the first. Each higher slot adds 1d4 to both.

mind_spike.name: Mind Spike
mind_spike.text: A spike of thought driven into a foe up to 120 feet away: 3d8 psychic, Wisdom save for half (concentration). The book also lets you know where it is for an hour; that is not in the game. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

mirror_image.name: Mirror Image
mirror_image.text: Three illusory copies of you crowd your space for a minute. When you are hit, a roll of 3 or more on a d6 for each copy sends the blow into one of them instead, and it is gone.

moonbeam.name: Moonbeam

again.name: Moonbeam: moved
again.text: While the spell holds, an action moves the beam to another spot; whoever it falls on must save.

moonbeam.text: A pale beam falls on a 5-foot circle up to 120 feet away (concentration): 2d10 radiant, Constitution save for half, to all caught in it, or who walk in or end a turn there. An action moves it. Each higher slot adds 1d10.

phantasmal_force.name: Phantasmal Force
phantasmal_force.text: An illusion plants itself in one foe's mind (concentration): on a failed Intelligence save it takes 2d8 psychic at the start of each of its turns, from some horror only it sees. Here it never sees through the lie.

prayer_of_healing.name: Prayer of Healing
prayer_of_healing.text: Ten minutes of prayer, never in a fight: up to five friends within 30 feet each heal 2d8, each higher slot adding 1d8. The book also gives them a short rest; here only the healing is given.

protection_from_poison.name: Protection from Poison
protection_from_poison.text: You touch a creature and end its poisoning; for an hour it resists poison damage. The book's advantage on saves against poison is not in the game.

ray_of_enfeeblement.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
ray_of_enfeeblement.text: A beam of weakness at a foe up to 60 feet away (concentration). On a failed Constitution save it is feeble in Strength and deals 1d8 less with each blow, saving again each turn; on a success its next attack has disadvantage.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.text: A deafening crack in a 10-foot radius up to 60 feet away: 3d8 thunder, Constitution save for half. Each higher slot adds 1d8. Constructs do not save worse here, as the book has them.

shining_smite.name: Shining Smite
shining_smite.text: Readied on the blade (concentration): the next melee hit flares with 2d6 more radiant, and the foe shines, so all attacks against it have advantage. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

silence.name: Silence
silence.text: No sound passes within a 20-foot radius up to 120 feet away (concentration, ten minutes): no spell with a spoken part can be cast inside. The book's thunder immunity and deafness are not in the game.

spike_growth.name: Spike Growth
spike_growth.text: Thorns and spikes cover a 20-foot-radius patch up to 150 feet away (concentration, ten minutes): hard going, and 2d4 piercing for every 5 feet anyone walks through it. No save.

suggestion.name: Suggestion
suggestion.text: A few honeyed words to a foe within 30 feet (concentration): on a failed Wisdom save it lays down its arms and waits, until it is hurt. The book lets you set it a task; in a fight here it only stands down.

warding_bond.name: Warding Bond
warding_bond.text: A bond with a willing creature you touch, for an hour: it gains +1 to Armour Class and saves and resists all damage, but you take every wound it takes. The platinum rings the book asks for are not counted.
